ev.q: In 2021, 13.6% of adults aged ≥18 years assessed their health as fair or poor.
The percentage of adults in fair or poor health decreased with increasing incomes for each age group.
The same pattern of increasing percentages with age was found for adults living in families with incomes 100% to <200% of FPL
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
Income was calculated as a percentage of FPL, which is based on family income and family size, using the U.S. Census Bureau’s poverty thresholds.
